description: Defines the torch::stable::Tensor class, a high-level, ABI-stable C++ wrapper around PyTorch tensor APIs, including constructors, data access, shape, device, and metadata functions.

classes.name: Tensor
classes.description: A high-level, ABI-stable C++ wrapper around PyTorch tensor APIs, providing metadata access, data pointers, device info, and construction methods.

methods.name: Tensor()
methods.description: Constructs a new uninitialized tensor with a handle managed via shared_ptr.

methods.name: Tensor(AtenTensorHandle)
methods.description: Constructs a tensor by taking ownership of an existing AtenTensorHandle.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns the underlying AtenTensorHandle.

methods.name: data_ptr()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the tensor's data.

methods.name: mutable_data_ptr()
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the tensor's data (if supported by version).

methods.name: const_data_ptr()
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to the tensor's data (if supported by version).

methods.name: sizes()
methods.description: Returns the shape of the tensor as an IntHeaderOnlyArrayRef.

methods.name: strides()
methods.description: Returns the strides of the tensor as an IntHeaderOnlyArrayRef.

methods.name: is_contiguous()
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is contiguous in memory.

methods.name: stride(int64_t)
methods.description: Returns the stride of a specific dimension.

methods.name: get_device()
methods.description: Returns the device index as int8_t, with range check.

methods.name: get_device_index()
methods.description: Returns the device index as int32_t (DeviceIndex).

methods.name: is_cuda()
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is on a CUDA device.

methods.name: is_cpu()
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is on the CPU.

methods.name: size(int64_t)
methods.description: Returns the size of a specific dimension.

methods.name: defined()
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is defined (not null).

methods.name: storage_offset()
methods.description: Returns the storage offset in number of elements.

methods.name: element_size()
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of each element.

methods.name: scalar_type()
methods.description: Returns the scalar type (dtype) of the tensor.

methods.name: device()
methods.description: Returns the device on which the tensor resides.
